program:
:- prefix(ex, 'https://example.org/1428/').
ex:sum(X, D) :- ex:qtyA(X, A), ex:qtyB(X, B), D is A + B.
?- ex:sum(X, D).

provenance.derivation: qtyA = 3 m (magnitude 3/1, dimension [1,0,0,0,0,0,0] = length). qtyB = 2 m (magnitude 2/1, same length dimension). Quantity `+` requires the two dimensions be commensurable (here: IDENTICAL length vectors, so trivially commensurable) and then adds the magnitudes: 3 + 2 = 5, keeping the shared dimension -- 5 m, i.e. magnitude 5/1 over [1,0,0,0,0,0,0].
provenance.note: independently derived; never hand-edited to match the native engine
